extracted.name: Very Easy Fruit Salad
extracted.description: Who knew that peach pie filling tasted so good when stirred into a bowl of sliced fruit - kiwi, bananas, grapes, and strawberries? Makes eight very generous servings.
ingredient_lines: 1 pint strawberries - cleaned, hulled and sliced
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, combine the strawberries, grapes, kiwis, and bananas. Gently mix in peaches. Chill for 1 hour before serving.
